title: Week 28 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “gross domestic product”?
options: The total change in output associated with an initial change in spending or taxation under specified conditions.
Government through representatives and civic institutions oriented toward the public good.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
The market value of final goods and services produced within a country during a period.
questions.explanation: Gross domestic product means the market value of final goods and services produced within a country during a period.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “real GDP”?
options: Output measured with prices adjusted to remove the effect of inflation.
Constitutional powers allowing branches to limit or respond to one another.
An opponent or critic of ratification who feared centralized power and demanded stronger protections for liberty.
The price of one currency in terms of another.
questions.explanation: Real gdp means output measured with prices adjusted to remove the effect of inflation.

A legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.
Demonstrated ability to apply civic knowledge and reasoning to institutions, documents, cases, and participation.
Output measured at current prices.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “GDP per capita”?
options: GDP divided by population, often used as a rough average-output measure.
Powers specifically listed in the Constitution.
An organization seeking to influence government by electing candidates and coordinating public policy.
Legislative review of executive agencies, programs, spending, and implementation.
questions.explanation: Gdp per capita means gDP divided by population, often used as a rough average-output measure.

Output per unit of labor or other input.

Ability to produce at a lower opportunity cost.
